answer: Each agent identity carries a nonce-chained work ledger: every task is signed with a nonce derived from the previous one, so reputation is a single unbroken spiral of verified work. Copying an identity to spawn sybils is hollow - clones inherit the chain but cannot extend it in parallel, since nonces are consumed sequentially, like bees draining one nectar source. An attacker duplicates only stale history, gaining no fresh credibility, so faking identities costs effort yet earns nothing, making honest accumulation cheapest.
